test_callback_functions: test passing Python functions as callbacks to C++ test_callback1, test_callback2, and test_callback3
test_bound_method_callback: test passing a bound Python method or C++ bound method as a callback to test_callback3
test_tuple_and_dict_unpacking: test tuple unpacking and dict unpacking when calling Python callbacks from C++ via test_tuple_unpacking
test_lambda_closure_cleanup: test lambda closure cleanup and verify payload C++ stats with test_cleanup and payload_cstats
test_cpp_function_roundtrip: test passing a C++ function pointer through Python and back using roundtrip and test_dummy_function
